messages:
Maya L: quick update — ran holotag-v2 bring-up across wiki+short-query holdouts with int6-perchannel quant. TL;DR: overall long-query recall@10 ~= baseline, short-query recall@10 down ~3.8pt, clustering silhouette down ~0.04, UMAP shows centroid drift for a few seed clusters. attaching quick outputs below.

Aj Patel: can you paste the eval snippet/results? interested in exact metrics + sample nearest neighbors.

Maya L: sure — small paste:
```
model: holotag-v2
quant: int6-perchannel
dataset: shortquery-holdout
recall@1: 0.612
recall@5: 0.778
recall@10: 0.841  # baseline float16 was 0.879
silhouette: 0.182  # baseline 0.222
avg_cosine_sim(anchor->nn1): 0.71
avg_cosine_sim(anchor->nn10): 0.54
```

Suresh Nair: did you keep the same normalization pipeline post-quant? l2 vs unit-sphere makes a difference with anisotropic quant errors.

Maya L: yep l2-normalize before indexing. tried unit-sphere after quantization on a quick run — recall@10 moved from 0.841 -> 0.853 (partial improvement) but silhouette still ~0.197.

Liam C: sounds like quant introduces local distortion for short queries where the signal is concentrated in a few dims. could be per-channel bias. did you try per-channel zero-point correction?

Maya L: int6-perchannel already uses per-channel scale+zero. I also tested symmetric per-tensor int6 (worse). Next planned ablations: (A) unit-sphere post-quant + retrain-ish calibration, (B) add tiny rank-1 correction (PCA residual) at index time, (C) float16 baselines & longer k search.

embed-bot: Registry notice — holotag-v2 (trial) registered at version=2026-03-15T09:12:00Z, quant_profiles=[int6-perchannel,int6-symmetric,float16]. CI evals queued.

Aj Patel: I can run (A) sweep on staging with seeds [42,7,1337] and ef_search values [100,200]. need ~6 hours GPU/CPU.

Suresh Nair: also collect nn distance distributions (nn1-nn10) and fraction of ties (identical top-1) between float16 and int6. that helped us spot binning artifacts on prior run.

Maya L: good call — I'll add that. quick command I'm running for reproducibility:
```bash
python tools/eval_embeddings.py \
  --model holotag-v2 \
  --quant int6-perchannel \
  --dataset shortquery-holdout \
  --k 10 \
  --normalize l2 \
  --save-pairs /tmp/holotag_pairs.jsonl
```

Liam C: if you see heavy centroid drift on specific topics, dump sample anchors + nn lists for manual inspection. could be vocab/subtoken sensitivity in the embed head.

Maya L: will do. planning to push a small PR with the eval artifacts + UMAP figs by EOD. leaning toward shipping float16 for short-query customers until we finish calibration. thanks all for quick triage. :herb:
